# T-2: Run automatic upgrade

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add post-operation upgrade orchestration to install and update-all while preserving excluded command responsibilities.

## Acceptance Criteria
- install invokes upgrade after successful install unless `--no-upgrade` is present.
- update-all invokes upgrade only when at least one result has `updated: true` and `--no-upgrade` is absent.
- source update and sync do not invoke upgrade.
- Upgrade failure preserves plugin result output and exits non-zero.

## Implementation Notes
`src/plugin.js` is the command boundary for deciding whether to run upgrade. Use a bounded single upgrade invocation per command execution. Run upgrade through a captured normal `senti upgrade` CLI entrypoint or an explicitly equivalent adapter that preserves entry initialization and converts stdout/stderr plus exit status into the upgrade result. Do not call upgrade in-process in a way that allows `process.exit` to bypass plugin output. Surface upgrade errors through output and exit status; do not silently swallow them.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local CLI tests observe upgrade invocation via deterministic test hook or fixture-visible side effect. A failure test forces upgrade failure and checks non-zero exit plus structured failure output.
